title: Lower Neumann BC to per-node force contributions on tagged surface
objective: Build (or extend) lowering/boundary.py so a Neumann BoundaryCondition is converted into per-node f_ext contributions over the tagged surface element set.

plan_assets.asset_description: Files list: lowering/boundary.py — new (or extended) module

scope: Map BoundaryCondition (traction, surface_tag) → list of (node_id, force_vector) contributions
Use existing surface element set lookup from mesh adapter
Quadrature/integration for traction over surface (per Voigt/index conventions)
implementation_steps: Read lowering pipeline entry point and identify where Element IR currently consumes Dirichlet BCs
Create lowering/boundary.py implementing lower_neumann(bc, surface_set, mesh) → list of nodal forces
Apply surface quadrature consistent with hex8 face integration (07-CONVENTIONS Voigt unscaled-shears)
Surface ElementIR f_ext_contributions field or analogous output structure
Cover with unit tests against handwritten reference for a single hex8 face traction
deliverables: Per-node force list output for Neumann BC
Unit test verifying total force = traction * surface_area for uniform traction
acceptance_criteria: Uniform traction "0 0 -1000" on a 1.0×1.0 hex8 face produces total nodal force [0, 0, -1000]
Non-tagged surface elements receive zero contribution
Index convention preserved: lowercase spatial indices on traction

cases: Single-face uniform traction → expected total force
Empty surface tag → empty contribution list
Lowercase spatial index convention preserved on traction

risks: Surface element set may not yet be indexable by tag — mitigation: extend mesh adapter or look up via existing sideset interface

commands.command: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu' -q

completion_notes: New module lowering/boundary.py exports lower_neumann, per_node_contributions, resolve_traction_vector, NodalForceContribution
Lowering delegates to codegen.boundary_codegen.compile_neumann; no quadrature duplicated
Symbolic-string traction (legacy 't_bar' form) requires an explicit traction_registry mapping; numeric tuple form passes through directly
Surface resolution uses bc.effective_surface_tag (P1-1 fallback to bc.name)
Mapping import moved to TYPE_CHECKING block (TC003 fix)
